extra.d: A bubble-pink starter blaster that pops out little heart shots. Fast and friendly.
Fiery gauntlets. Quick jabs, and every 4th punch is a flaming Dragon Uppercut.
A six-shooter with a blossom grip. The 6th shot is a Blossom Shot that bursts into petals, then it reloads.
A pink katana. Hits build Bloom; at full Bloom the next swing releases a piercing petal wave.
A flared bubble blunderbuss. Six pellets in a wide spread with big knockback. Best up close.
A coral trident. Its thrust sends a rolling wave along the ground that sweeps monsters away.
A cat-eared rapid blaster. Hold the mouse to spray a stream of paw-print shots.
A magic pistol. Homing moon shots split into three seeking star shards when they hit.
Hold to charge, release to fire a beam that pierces every monster in a line. Full charge deals 2.6x.
Summons three light wisps that orbit you and shoot nearby monsters. Click again for a volley.
Fires a firework rocket that explodes in a shower of colours. Splash damage, never breaks blocks.
Thunder arrows. Each one calls a lightning strike where it lands that chains to nearby monsters.
A floating prism focuses a rainbow bolt that ricochets off walls and arcs to nearby monsters.
A huge dragon-scale axe. Cleaves in front of you and hurls a spinning fire axe that comes back.

Long veils of running water that never quite fall. Light ripples through them as you fly. Needs level 38. Gives a double jump.
Soft pastel wings of sea foam, shedding small round bubbles with every beat. Needs level 24. Gives a double jump.
Vast dragon wings whose membranes are open windows on a violet night sky, veined with gold. Needs level 60. Gives a double jump.
Three tiers of burning comet tails, streaming back from the shoulders. Needs level 46. Gives a double jump.
Layered silk feathers the colour of a spring dusk. Petals follow you. Needs level 28. Gives a double jump.
Burning feathers rimmed in white heat, dropping embers as they fold. Needs level 42. Gives a double jump.
Brass clockwork panels on oiled hinges, turning over with a quiet tick. Needs level 32. Gives a double jump.
Great wet strokes of black ink in the shape of a dragon's wings. They spatter as you turn. Needs level 58. Gives a double jump.
